outcome_definition: Outcome = CLSI-style limit of blank for ONE mutant assay: FAM+/HEX- droplet counts in blank (wild-type-only) wells. fam_positive_droplets is the reported count; blank_fa is the mutant fractional abundance in the same wells. A 0 here means no false-positive droplet in N blanks - it does NOT mean the assay is false-positive free, only that the observed rate is below 1/N.

Outcome = limit of detection for ONE mutant assay: the lowest serial-dilution point at which EVERY replicate exceeded LoB (n_replicates here equals the exceeding count printed by the paper). lod_fa is the printed fractional abundance; lod_fa_from_merged is recomputed from the merged droplet counts and is kept as a CHECK, not a replacement - the merged counts are sums over replicates, so a perfect match is not expected.
